## Description

Please include a detailed summary of the change, the problem it solves, and any context or design rationale. If applicable, specify which issues this PR resolves.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

Please mark the options that are relevant:

- [ ] **Bug fix** (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] **New feature** (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] **Breaking change** (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] **Refactoring** (code structure change with no behavior modifications)
- [ ] **Documentation Update** (additions or corrections to docs)

## How Has This Been Tested?

Describe the steps you took to verify your changes. Include details of your local environment and what tests you executed.

- [ ] **Automated Tests:** Did you run `node scripts/final_comprehensive_test.js` or other integration test scripts? (Please describe)
- [ ] **Linter Check:** Did you run `npm run lint` and verify it passes with zero errors?
- [ ] **Duplication Check:** Did you run `npx jscpd src --threshold 10`?
- [ ] **Manual Verification:** Did you test this in your browser locally at `http://localhost:5173`? Describe the user flow tested.

### Visual Changes (if applicable)
